title: ctxroute — configuration
description: GLOBAL config of the framework (maintainer decision 17/07/2026: the JSON does ONLY global — per-doc cadence lives in the doc's frontmatter, never here. Zero duplication between the two). Cascade: doc frontmatter > global defaults here.

cadence.description: Cadence settings — SAME vocabulary as an entry (anti-synonym law: one concept = one word, whatever the stage). All keys optional.

note.description: AUTHOR COMMENT — never read by the engine. Here: 'why this default for this WHOLE category'. ⚠️ ADDED on 05/08/2026 by the vocabulary-symmetry gate, which found the gap on its first run: `note` existed in file docs, MCP docs and skill entries, but NOT in `defaults.{source}` — an omission, not a decision. Symmetry is the DEFAULT; every exception must be justified in writing.

enforce.description: REFUSE the action instead of informing (05/08/2026). ⚠️ Only meaningful for a category whose docs are ALL in `mode: once` — the engine honors `enforce` only on an EFFECTIVE `once` mode (anti-loop guarantee in gate.js), otherwise it informs. Setting `enforce` on a whole category is DISCOURAGED: every first action of a session would be refused, and a system people endure ends up unplugged. Reserved for irreversible actions, doc by doc. An entry can opt out with `enforce: false`.

filterMode.description: PER-TARGET FILTER, for THIS doc category (52, 15/08/2026) — SAME words, same meaning as the global one. A `"none"` declared here UNSUBSCRIBES the category from a global filter (mirror of the explicit `enforce: false` — without it the stage could not be opted out of). The filterMode+filterList pair cascades TOGETHER: the stage that provides the mode provides its list.

filterList.description: TARGETS of this category's filterMode: MCP server, exact tool name, or wildcard "*" (52, 15/08/2026).

enabled.description: GLOBAL switch — false cuts EVERYTHING (injection AND tracking). Distinct from showNotification.

showNotification.description: Controls ONLY the visual 📄 badge — false hides the badge, the real injection continues.

mode.description: dumb = re-injects on every call (debug only, never in a shipped config — gated). once = 1st call then silence until compaction. smart = once + re-injection after N calls to other tools.

defaultThreshold.description: The N of smart mode: number of calls to OTHER tools before re-injection.

defaultDriftUnit.description: GLOBAL unit of the smart counter (18/07/2026): tool = tool calls (framework default, historical behavior); turn = conversation turns (counter fed by turn-count.js on UserPromptSubmit). Cascade: entry driftUnit (doc frontmatter / skill entry) > defaultDriftUnit > framework default 'tool'. Degenerate outside smart (dumb=0, once=∞).

budgetInjection.description: Emission budget of one injection, in CHARACTERS (31/07/2026). Every harness bounds the size of an injection and FILES the overflow away without telling the producer — the agent then receives an intro while believing it holds the whole contract. This budget keeps the output under that wall: whatever does not fit is ANNOUNCED (name + path), never silently lost. Cascade: framework default (budget.js) > harness limit declared by the shell > this key. ⚠️ This key can only REDUCE the budget (Math.min): the harness limit is physical, exceeding it would restore silent truncation at the very moment you think you are loosening the constraint.

frames.description: NUMBER OF FRAMES declared for ONE action — the framework's BANDWIDTH (07/08/2026). Default 12. Capacity of an action = frames × (budgetInjection − envelope); measured 07/08/2026: 12 × 7,661 = 91,932 characters, for a real worst-case load of 65,265 c (71%). What overflows is NEVER lost (emission queue) but lands on the NEXT action — so the agent will have acted on partial knowledge. ⚠️ THIS KEY DRIVES NOTHING AT RUNTIME: the harness launches exactly the processes declared in ITS wiring (settings.json), cold, and no extra frame can be created during a call. It is the SOURCE OF TRUTH that `doctor.js --settings` confronts with the real wiring — two places for one number diverge silently, defect MEASURED on 05/08/2026 (a skill delivered over 11 actions instead of 1, 995 green tests). ⚠️ RAISING IT COSTS: each frame is a process launched on EVERY tool call, even empty (~330 ms measured) — 12 ⇒ ~4 s, 50 ⇒ ~17 s. Don't inflate 'just in case'; the overflow alarm says when it is justified.

filterMode.description: GLOBAL PER-TARGET FILTER (generalized 15/08/2026, work item 52 — it used to target MCP servers only: class ㊴). whitelist = the framework only injects on actions whose target is in filterList. blacklist = never on those targets ('NEVER inject on our production tools'). An excluded target still counts as 'foreign' for the other docs' counters. SINGLE application point = gate.js, exclusion OBSERVABLE (badge + explain.js). Also tunable PER CATEGORY via defaults.{source}.filterMode — a `"none"` declared there UNSUBSCRIBES the category from a global filter.

filterList.description: TARGETS of the filterMode: MCP SERVER name ("stripe" — historical semantics), exact TOOL name ("Bash", "mcp__stripe__pay"), or wildcard "*" (52, 15/08/2026). The filterMode+filterList pair cascades TOGETHER: the stage that provides the mode provides its list.

servers.description: STRUCTURAL per-server settings (routing), NEVER cadence: per-doc mode/threshold = the doc's frontmatter (keys removed from the schema 17/07/2026, zero duplication).

subToolParam.description: Dotted path of the param carrying the real operation of a single-tool proxy MCP (e.g. "args.tool" for Odoo) — enables level 3, docs/mcp/{server}/{subTool}.md.

skillsWithoutPerimeter.description: SKILLS DELIBERATELY WITHOUT A PERIMETER + SWITCH of the zero-silence discipline (19/07/2026 — mirror of `inject: never`). EXPLICIT OPT-IN: the presence of THIS key (even []) activates the reverse direction of skill-registry-gate; absent = no exhaustiveness required (using `skills` imposes NOTHING — a language never imposes a policy). Every harness skill MUST be EITHER registered in `skills` (auto-injection by perimeter) OR listed HERE (reference/on-demand, manual invocation). A skill in NEITHER list = RED (skill-registry-gate, reverse direction) — a FORGOTTEN perimeter and a deliberately silent skill are indistinguishable without this declaration.

defaults.description: PER-SOURCE DEFAULTS — 3rd stage of the cascade (04/08/2026). Generalizes the old `skillDefaults`, which offered that stage only to skills: between the global ('the whole corpus') and the entry ('this very doc'), 'all docs of THIS category' was missing. Full cascade, 4 stages: entry (frontmatter/registry) > defaults.{source} > global (mode/defaultThreshold/defaultDriftUnit) > FRAMEWORK default. TOTAL fallback at every stage: absent key or invalid value ⇒ we go down, never an error. EVERYTHING is optional — `defaults` absent = previous behavior, identical. ⚠️ DELIBERATE ASYMMETRY, do not 'fix' it: the `skill` source does NOT consult the global (its framework default is `once`, the docs' is `smart`) — a skill is project knowledge, a doc is an action reminder. Making them uniform would change the behavior of all skills the moment a global config is set. ⚠️ NO `session` key HERE, and it is not an omission: docs/session/ docs are delivered by session-inject.js (SessionStart/PostCompact), which consults NEITHER gate.decide NOR any cadence — they inject once per context, by construction. A `session` key would be ACCEPTED and INERT, i.e. the false green this repo killed on 31/07 (`mcp:` in a docs/ doc). The keys admitted here are exactly the `id`s of the source-adapters.js registry — sealed by a gate.

file.description: Default for docs triggered by PATH (frontmatter match/rules).

skill.description: Default for perimeter skills (ex-`skillDefaults`, same semantics).

tool.description: Default for docs triggered by a native TOOL NAME (frontmatter tool:).

skills.description: Registry of skills triggered by PERIMETER (18/07/2026). GLOBAL config that the framework OWNS — never inside the skill file itself (harness property, unmastered format, fragile to updates: doctrine 'frontmatter only in what we control 100%'). Key = skill name (= the harness's {key}.md skill file, sealed by skill-registry-gate). Injects the skill's BODY read live (single source — pointer fallback if unreadable). Matching = the SAME as the file source (matchingDocs reused), SAME vocabulary as the docs: match/scope/exclude.

anyOf.description: BARE WILDCARD FORBIDDEN (EXACT parity with frontmatter.validate): `tool: ["*"]` without `scope` or `exclude` would inject the WHOLE skill on EVERY tool call. The wildcard exists to say 'whatever the tool, WHEN this' — the WHEN is mandatory.

rules.description: PER-ENTRY FORM (19/07/2026, doc parity): DIFFERENT conditions per pattern — [{"pattern":"deploy.sh","scope":["project-a"]},{"pattern":"clients"}]. Replaces match/scope/exclude (mixing them = a contradiction, two truths = drift). A homogeneous skill keeps the simple match/scope/exclude format.

scope.description: FLAT FORM = OR (inherited, untouched) - GROUPED FORM = AND of ORs (㊺①, 14/08/2026): [["a"],["b"]] = a AND b, [["a","b"],["c"]] = (a OR b) AND c. EXACT MIRROR of frontmatter.js::formeScopeErreur - two form declarations that diverge = class ㊴, invisible to a gate that probes the PRESENCE of a key. 🛑 MIXED forms REFUSED (oneOf): the danger of this extension is AMBIGUITY, not the limit - an author writing ["a","b"] meaning AND gets an OR, hence a WIDER rule, SILENTLY.

keys.description: WHICH parameter keys this entry may see. Flat list = the same universe for the three axes; object = one universe PER axis (match/scope/exclude). A name prefixed with '-' REMOVES the key from the default universe (blacklist); without the prefix the list REPLACES it (whitelist), which is what allows an entry to read a key the harness profile never declared. MIXED forms are refused: the danger is ambiguity, not the limit. MIRROR of frontmatter.validate — the two declarations must not diverge (class 34: a gate probing a key's PRESENCE never sees its FORM).

match.description: FILE DIMENSION — substring patterns (same rules as file match): when a tool param contains one, the skill injects. Pick strings DISTINCTIVE of the project (over-genericity = over-injection).

servers.description: MCP DIMENSION, 3 GRAINS (18/07/2026, same levels as MCP docs): "infra" = any tool of the server · "gworkspace/send_mail" = THAT precise tool (suffix of mcp__{server}__{tool}) · "odoo/create_invoice" = THAT sub-tool (via servers.{server}.subToolParam). Lib primitives reused (serverName/toolSuffix/getByPath — zero new matching). A project is worked through files AND through MCP — the 2 dimensions are a UNION.

tool.description: TOOL DIMENSION (㊴, 12/08/2026) — EXACT tool name (===, never a substring) + wildcard "*". SAME word, SAME meaning as the docs' frontmatter `tool:`: no vocabulary created, we extend the usage to a source that lacked it. This is what finally lets a skill react to an ACTION (with `scope`, which sees ALL params) and not only to a PLACE. A skill could NOT react to a parameter's CONTENT: real measured cost = a client email drafted without its folder.

mode.description: Cadence (default once). Skills = a NEW source with no legacy parity → once/smart FREE from day one (unlike file docs, held at dumb until the Codex port).

threshold.description: The N of smart mode for this skill.

driftUnit.description: Unit of the smart counter for THIS skill: tool (tool calls) or turn (conversation turns). Last word of the cascade.

enforce.description: REFUSE the action instead of informing (05/08/2026) — SAME word, SAME meaning as the docs' frontmatter (anti-synonym law). ⚠️ Only effective with an EFFECTIVE `once` mode (skills' framework default): gate.js NEVER honors `enforce` on `dumb`/`smart`, otherwise the blocked agent retries and gets re-blocked ENDLESSLY. An explicit `false` CANCELS the `defaults.skill` inheritance.

note.description: AUTHOR COMMENT (04/08/2026) — the ONLY field the engine NEVER reads. Addressee = whoever comes to MODIFY this entry ('why this mode', 'why this scope', 're-check after such version'), not the agent that acts. Exact mirror of the docs' frontmatter `note` key: one concept = one word, whatever the corpus. 🛑 BOUND: NEVER the why of an INVARIANT — that one stays in the body, visible to the acting agent; an invariant deprived of its reason drifts.

exclude.description: Patterns to reject (matched on the current path/command) — homonyms (node_modules, dist...).

scope.description: FLAT FORM = OR (inherited, untouched) - GROUPED FORM = AND of ORs (㊺①, 14/08/2026): [["a"],["b"]] = a AND b, [["a","b"],["c"]] = (a OR b) AND c. EXACT MIRROR of frontmatter.js::formeScopeErreur - two form declarations that diverge = class ㊴, invisible to a gate that probes the PRESENCE of a key. 🛑 MIXED forms REFUSED (oneOf): the danger of this extension is AMBIGUITY, not the limit - an author writing ["a","b"] meaning AND gets an OR, hence a WIDER rule, SILENTLY.

A name prefixed with '-' REMOVES the key from the default universe (blacklist); without the prefix the list REPLACES it (whitelist), which is what allows an entry to read a key the harness profile never declared. MIXED forms are refused: the danger is ambiguity, not the limit. MIRROR of frontmatter.validate — the two declarations must not diverge (class 34: a gate probing a key's PRESENCE never sees its FORM).
